description: Defines minimal TypeScript types for Microsoft Teams SDK entities such as MSTeamsActivity and MSTeamsTurnContext, serving as public surface/interfaces used by other parts of the project to abstract SDK details.

methods.name: sendActivity
methods.description: Sends an activity (message or event) to the user or conversation.

methods.name: sendActivities
methods.description: Sends an array of activities to the user or conversation.

methods.name: updateActivity
methods.description: Updates an existing activity in the conversation.

methods.name: deleteActivity
methods.description: Deletes an activity from the conversation by activity ID.
